violation_type.title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)
violation_type.typical_finding: The provider did not have the fencing up around the outdoor play area.

finding_variants.text: The provider did not have the fencing up around the outdoor play area.
The outdoor play area did not have a enclosed, fenced area.
The fence  to the play area had a opening at the bottom were the fence was not enclosed all the way.
The provider stated the children are not taken to the fenced area for outdoor play.  The children are taken to the front of the home.
The backyard playground area fence is only 41 inches high. During the inspection there were two children younger than five years old on the backyard.
Some areas of the backyard fence used for outdoor play were below the required minimum 4 feet high.

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: The children were utilizing an outdoor space that was not fully fenced in. The operation is planning on only using the fenced in play area until they extend the fence in the future.
